title: Citizen Weather Observer Consistency Score
dataSources: Seismograph (`seismo:reading`), Geiger counter (`geiger:cpm`), lightning strikes (`lightning:strike`), radon (`radon:reading`), all-sky meteor camera (`allsky:capture`), river-level gauge (`riverlevel:reading`), magnetometer (`magnetometer:reading`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`).
app: DIY citizen-science sensors — Raspberry Shake seismograph, Geiger counter, AS3935/Blitzortung lightning detector, radon monitor, all-sky meteor camera, river-level gauge, and magnetometer — via MQTT and scripted inputs to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=citizenweather:obs
bin _time span=1d
stats count as reports by station_id _time
where reports<4
description: Flags Citizen Weather stations with incomplete daily reporting.
value: Surfacing citizen weather observer consistency score helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant citizen science & backyard sensing export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up when citizen weather observer consistency score matters for your routine.
